rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Integrates with Twitter's API using OAuth 1.0a authentication and the twitter-api-v2 library to enable comprehensive Twitter interactions. Supports posting text tweets, posting tweets with images in multiple formats (JPG, PNG, GIF, WEBP), searching for tweets with query-based filtering, and managing threaded conversations through reply functionality. Features built-in rate limiting protection to prevent API quota exhaustion and comprehensive error handling for robust social media automation workflows.
